title: Cable Superset Workout
description: A five-session cable program built around upper, lower, and antagonist supersets. Keep compounds and isolation work at 1–2 RIR; the final isolation set may reach 0–1 RIR. Progress each exercise independently with double progression.

title: Short Full Body — Gym
description: Two short full-body workouts (A and B) on gym equipment: about 30 minutes, 2 sets each, easy on purpose. A good way back in.

title: Short Full Body — Home
description: Two short full-body workouts (A and B) with dumbbells, a kettlebell and bands: about 30 minutes, 2 sets each. Easy on purpose.

title: Short Full Body — No Equipment
description: Two short full-body workouts (A and B) with just your body and a band: about 30 minutes, 2 sets each. Easy on purpose.
